title: Personal data in practice
intro: Other people's data is in your care. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Leave request

artifact.subject: Leave request
body: Please sign your request in the internal document system. No extra documents needed.

decisions.explain: The domain is correct, it points to the internal system and asks for no extra data.

decisions.title: Message from +994 50 000 22 90

body: Hello, I'm from the police. Send me Rashad Aliyev's registered address and phone, it's urgent.

decisions.explain: Authorities request data through official channels, not by message from a personal number.

decisions.title: Message from Elvin, colleague

artifact.name: Elvin, colleague
body: My neighbour applied to us. What's in his file? Send me a photo, I'm curious.

decisions.explain: Curiosity is not a work need. If the job does not require it, the file is not shared.

decisions.title: The list

artifact.subject: The list
body: Send all the department's ID codes and phones to my personal email, I'll work from home: leyla.h.1990@mail.example

decisions.explain: Even for a known colleague, personal data must not go to a personal mailbox. It stays in work systems.

decisions.title: Message from DovletPortal

artifact.name: DovletPortal
body: Your application has been received. You can see the result in your account on the portal.

decisions.explain: There is no link and nothing is requested. It only informs you.
